name: Prometheus Avatar
description: Give your OpenClaw agent a Live2D avatar (lip-sync · emotion · TTS) plus AAA image generation for marketplace skin previews. 3 agent tools + bundled skill.
author: Myths Labs

avatarId.description: Reserved: marketplace avatar ID. ID-based model resolution is not available yet — use modelUrl (a .model3.json URL) to pick a model; when only avatarId is set the default model is used.

apiKey.description: Prometheus agent API key (pak_...) used for marketplace deploys. Falls back to the PROMETHEUS_API_KEY environment variable. Get one at prometheus.mythslabs.ai/settings/agent-keys.

modelUrl.description: Direct URL to a Live2D model file (.model3.json)

ttsProvider.description: DEPRECATED in v0.10.0 — this field is ignored. TTS is now delegated to the Prometheus SDK (@prometheusavatar/core) which uses the Prometheus voice backend. Kept for backward compat only.

ttsVoice.description: Prometheus Marketplace voice ID (e.g. saturn_zh_female_keainvsheng_tob). Browse available voices at prometheus.mythslabs.ai/marketplace.
